title: Minimally Invasive Coral Biopsy Technique for In-Situ Microbiome and Metabolome Sampling
author: Justin T Berg
materials: 16 Gauge 1/2 Inch Blunt Tipped Dispensing Needle - Luer Lock

steps.title: Prepare Sampling Materials
steps.instruction: Organize and label tubes based on the target analysis: microbiome or metabolome.

substeps.instruction: For microbiome sampling: Pair 1.5mL conical bottom snap cap tubes with 2.0mL free standing screw cap tubes; label each pair identically.
For metabolome sampling: Pair 1.5mL conical bottom snap cap tubes with 2mL Glass Amber Vial tubes; label each pair identically.
Use a permanent marker on 1.5mL snap cap tubes to prevent label degradation in seawater.
Place one 16 Gauge 1/2 Inch Blunt Tipped Dispensing Needle - Luer Lock TM tip into each 1.5mL snap cap tube and close the lid.
Organize 1.5mL tubes in a rack (for land samples) or labeled plastic bags (for diving).
Organize 2mL screw cap tubes or 2mL Glass Amber Vials in a labeled cryo box for -80°C storage.

steps.title: Perform Coral Biopsy (Blunt Tip)
steps.instruction: Collect coral tissue using the blunt-tipped needle according to the sampling environment.

substeps.instruction: Wear nitrile gloves to reduce contamination.

Ex-situ: Remove coral from tank; remove needle tip from 1.5mL tube; insert needle 2-3 mm into tissue; lightly push to one side or gently rock for denser skeletons to break the biopsy; return coral to tank and place needle with biopsy into the 1.5mL tube.

Free-diving/Snorkeling: Remove needle tip from 1.5mL tube (keep tube closed); allow water to enter the needle tip near the coral to avoid air bubbles; insert needle (apply more pressure for bouldering corals like Porites lobata); push tip to the side for a clean break; keep thumb on Luer-Lok plastic during ascent to prevent biopsy loss; place needle with biopsy into the 1.5mL tube on the surface.

Scuba Diving: Descend to area; remove needle tip from 1.5mL tube; insert needle (apply more pressure for bouldering corals like Porites lobata); push tip to the side or rock back and forth for denser skeletons; keep thumb on Luer-Lok plastic and place needle back into the 1.5mL tube (which will fill with seawater).

steps.title: Perform Alternate Bevel Tipped Biopsy
steps.instruction: Use the bevel-tipped technique for harder skeletons or larger polyps (e.g., Orbicella faveolata).

substeps.instruction: Prepare labeled 5mL syringes attached to 16 Gauge 1 Inch Bevel Tipped Luer Lock Dispensing Needles with original caps on.
While free-diving or scuba diving, uncap the syringe and place the sharp edge of the needle in the coral polyp mouth.
Apply pressure and twist around the polyp until the sample is free.
Recap the needle immediately to secure the sample in the tip/cap.
Store syringes in a cooler during transport to a sterile environment.

steps.title: Transfer Biopsies to Storage Tubes
steps.instruction: Transfer the collected biopsy from the needle tip into the final 2mL storage tube using air pressure.

substeps.instruction: For Blunt Tip (Ex-situ/Free-diving): Remove needle from 1.5mL tube and attach to a 25mL Luer-Lok TM Syringe containing air; aim into a 2mL screw cap tube (microbiome) or 2mL Glass Amber Vial (metabolome); push syringe plunger to force biopsy out with air.

For Blunt Tip (Scuba): Use sterile forceps to remove the submerged needle from the 1.5mL tube and attach to a 25mL Luer-Lok TM Syringe containing air; aim into the 2mL storage tube and push plunger to force biopsy out.

For Bevel Tip: Remove needle from syringe with cap attached; extend syringe to fill with 3mL of air; reattach needle; remove cap; use air to eject sample into the 2mL tube, or use sterile forceps if the sample is in the cap.
If biopsy does not eject, remove needle, add more air to the syringe, and retry (do not add air while needle is attached).
Discard used needles and close storage tubes.

steps.title: Preserve and Store Samples
steps.instruction: Add preservation reagents to the storage tubes and freeze.

substeps.instruction: Microbiome: Use a pipette and 200uL tips to add 100uL of DNA/RNA Shield to the 2mL screw cap tube, ensuring the sample is submerged.
Metabolome: Use a Glass Pasteur Pipette to add 500uL of 70% LCMS-Methanol to the 2mL Glass Amber Vial, ensuring the sample is submerged.
Place all samples in a cryo box and store in a -80°C freezer.
